Flight arrives 10:00 am. We allow 1 h 15 min to get off the plane and through baggage claim (and passport control after a flight from abroad). Your bags go with you to the ship: porters take them at the cruise terminal.
You fly in the day the ship sails, so today goes straight from the airport to the ship: there isn't enough time for sightseeing with a safe margin.
